license_required.quote: Only a person licensed or otherwise authorized to practice under this article shall practice dentistry or use the title "dentist".
license_required.citation: 6602 - Practice of Dentistry and Use of Title "Dentist".

issuing_authority.quote: Admission to practice of a profession in this state is accomplished by a license being issued to a qualified applicant by the education department.

name.quote: file an application with the department
name.citation: 6604 - Requirements for a License as a Dentist.

type.quote: Admission to practice of a profession in this state is accomplished by a license being issued to a qualified applicant by the education department.

moral_character_required.quote: Character: be of good moral character as determined by the department;

required.quote: such experience shall consist of satisfactory completion of a postdoctoral general practice or specialty dental residency program, of at least one year's duration, in a hospital or dental facility accredited for teaching purposes by a national accrediting body approved by the department
required.citation: 6604 - Requirements for a License as a Dentist.

duration.quote: of at least one year's duration

kind.citation: 6604 - Requirements for a License as a Dentist.

exams.name: Written examination in dentistry
exams.notes: Written examination satisfactory to the board and in accordance with the commissioner's regulations
exams.quote: Examination: pass a written examination satisfactory to the board and in accordance with the commissioner's regulations;
exams.citation: 6604 - Requirements for a License as a Dentist.

interval_years.quote: a fee of two hundred ten dollars for each triennial registration period.

required.quote: Each dentist, licensed pursuant to this article, required to register triennially with the department to practice in this state shall comply with the provisions of the mandatory continuing education requirements

hours_per_period.quote: complete a minimum of sixty hours of acceptable formal continuing education

period_years.quote: During each triennial registration period an applicant for registration shall complete a minimum of sixty hours of acceptable formal continuing education

value: dental jurisprudence and ethics (3 hours, one-time)
tobacco use and oral health effects (2 hours, one-time)
child abuse and maltreatment identification and reporting (2 hours)
topical_requirements.quote: no fewer than three hours in a course approved by the department in dental jurisprudence and ethics, which shall include the laws, rules, regulations and ethical principles relating to the practice of dentistry in New York state

available.quote: Indorse a license issued by a licensing board of another state or country upon the applicant fulfilling the following requirements

requirements.value: Applicant must file an application, meet educational requirements, have satisfactory experience, pass an examination, be at least 21, be a US citizen or lawful permanent resident, and be of good moral character as determined by the department.
requirements.quote: Indorse a license issued by a licensing board of another state or country upon the applicant fulfilling the following requirements: (a) Application; (b) Education; (c) Experience; (d) Examination; (e) Age: be at least twenty-one years of age; (f) Citizenship or immigration status; (g) Character

exists.quote: The department assisted by the board for each profession, shall: a. Establish standards for preprofessional and professional education, experience and licensing examinations

scope_protection.quote: Anyone not authorized to practice under this title who practices or offers to practice or holds himself out as being able to practice in any profession in which a license is a prerequisite to the practice of the acts

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing fraudulently, beyond authorized scope, with gross incompetence, gross negligence, or repeated negligence/incompetence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing the profession fraudulently, beyond its authorized scope, with gross incompetence, with gross negligence on a particular occasion or negligence or incompetence on more than one occasion,

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing while ability is impaired by alcohol, drugs, physical disability, or mental disability
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing the profession while the ability to practice is impaired by alcohol, drugs, physical disability, or mental disability,

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being habitually drunk or dependent on or habitual user of narcotics, barbiturates, amphetamines, hallucinogens, or similar drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being habitually drunk or being dependent on, or a habitual user of narcotics, barbiturates, amphetamines, hallucinogens, or other drugs having similar effects,

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted of committing an act constituting a crime under NY, federal, or equivalent out-of-state law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted of committing an act constituting a crime under: (i) New York State law or, (ii) Federal law or, (iii) The law of another jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having been found guilty of improper professional practice or misconduct by a duly authorized professional disciplinary agency of another state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having been found guilty of improper professional practice or professional misconduct by a duly authorized professional disciplinary agency of another state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having been found by the commissioner of health to be in violation of article thirty-three of the public health law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having been found by the commissioner of health to be in violation of article thirty-three of the public health law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a license to practice medicine revoked, suspended, or subjected to disciplinary action in another state for conduct constituting misconduct in NY
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having his license to practice medicine revoked, suspended or having other disciplinary action taken, or having his application for a license refused, revoked or suspended

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusing to provide professional service because of a person's race, creed, color, or national origin
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Refusing to provide professional service to a person because of such person's race, creed, color, or national origin,

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting, aiding, or abetting an unlicensed person to perform activities requiring a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Permitting, aiding or abetting an unlicensed person to perform activities requiring a license,

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing while the license is suspended, or willfully failing to register or notify the department of name/address change
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing the profession while the license is suspended, or wilfully failing to register or notify the department of any change of name or mailing address,

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing unprofessional conduct as defined by the board of regents or commissioner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing unprofessional conduct, as defined by the board of regents in its rules or by the commissioner in regulations approved by the board of regents,

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of section 6505-b (infection control practices) by a professional other than one subject to certain public health law provisions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A violation of section six thousand five hundred five-b of this chapter by a professional other than a professional subject to the provisions of paragraph (f) of subdivision one of section twenty-eight hundred five-k of the public health law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Directly or indirectly requesting, receiving, or participating in the division, rebate, or splitting of a fee in connection with professional care or services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has directly or indirectly requested, received or participated in the division, transference, assignment, rebate, splitting or refunding of a fee for, or has directly requested, received or profited by means of a credit or other valuable consideration as a commission, discount or gratuity in connection with the furnishing of professional care, or service

establishment_regulation_required.quote: The department is empowered to inspect and to have access to all places, including the office or offices of a licensed dentist, where copies of dental laboratory prescriptions issued by him are retained

definition_quote.value: The practice of the profession of dentistry is defined as diagnosing, treating, operating, or prescribing for any disease, pain, injury, deformity, or physical condition of the oral and maxillofacial area related to restoring and maintaining dental health. The practice of dentistry includes the prescribing and fabrication of dental prostheses and appliances. The practice of dentistry may include performing physical evaluations in conjunction with the provision of dental treatment.
definition_quote.quote: The practice of the profession of dentistry is defined as diagnosing, treating, operating, or prescribing for any disease, pain, injury, deformity, or physical condition of the oral and maxillofacial area related to restoring and maintaining dental health.

value: prescribing and fabricating dental prostheses and appliances
performing physical evaluations in conjunction with dental treatment
methods_authorized.quote: diagnosing, treating, operating, or prescribing for any disease, pain, injury, deformity, or physical condition of the oral and maxillofacial area

drug_authority.value: Dentists may prescribe for conditions of the oral and maxillofacial area; may use local anesthesia and nitrous oxide without a certificate; conscious sedation, deep sedation, or general anesthesia requires a dental anesthesia certificate.
drug_authority.quote: Nothing in this section shall limit a dentist's use of local anesthesia, a dentist's use of nitrous oxide, or a dentist's use of any other substance or agent for a purpose other than achieving deep sedation, conscious sedation, or general anesthesia.

sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: A licensed dentist shall not employ conscious sedation, deep sedation or general anesthesia in the practice of dentistry, at any location other than a general hospital, without a dental anesthesia certificate issued by the department.

value: personal supervision of a licensed dentist
collaborative arrangement with a licensed and registered dentist (for hospital-based registered dental hygienists)
dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: must be done either under the supervision of a licensed dentist or, in the case of a registered dental hygienist working for a hospital as defined in article twenty-eight of the public health law, pursuant to a collaborative arrangement with a licensed and registered dentist who has a formal relationship with the same hospital
dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.citation: 6606 - Definition of Practice of Dental Hygiene.

collaborative_agreement_available.quote: in the case of a registered dental hygienist working for a hospital as defined in article twenty-eight of the public health law, pursuant to a collaborative arrangement with a licensed and registered dentist who has a formal relationship with the same hospital in accordance with regulations promulgated by the department in consultation with the department of health.
collaborative_agreement_available.citation: 6606 - Definition of Practice of Dental Hygiene.

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: Legally incorporated dental corporations existing and in operation prior to January first, nineteen hundred sixteen, may continue to operate through licensed dentists while conforming to the provisions of this title. Any such corporation which shall be dissolved or cease to exist or operate for any reason whatsoever shall not be permitted to resume operations.

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: Except upon the written dental laboratory prescription of a licensed dentist and except by the use of impressions or casts made by a licensed dentist, no dental laboratory shall furnish, supply, construct, reproduce, place, adjust, or repair any dental prosthesis, device, or appliance.

denture_patient_identification_marking_r.quote: every dentist licensed in this state making or directing to be made a removable prosthetic denture, bridge, appliance or other structure to be used and worn as a substitute for natural teeth, shall offer to the patient for whom the prosthesis is intended the opportunity to have such prosthesis marked with the patient's name or initials.
denture_patient_identification_marking_r.citation: 6612 - Identification of Removable Full or Partial Prosthetic Devices.

hygienist_local_anesthesia_certification.quote: A dental hygienist shall not administer or monitor nitrous oxide analgesia or local infiltration anesthesia in the practice of dental hygiene without a dental hygiene restricted local infiltration anesthesia/nitrous oxide analgesia certificate

hygienist_nitrous_oxide_certification_re.quote: A dental hygienist shall not administer or monitor nitrous oxide analgesia or local infiltration anesthesia in the practice of dental hygiene without a dental hygiene restricted local infiltration anesthesia/nitrous oxide analgesia certificate

patient_record_retention_years.quote: One copy shall be retained by the practitioner of dentistry for a period of one year.

cpr_certification_required_for_sedation.quote: Each dentist and registered dental hygienist working for a hospital as defined in article twenty-eight of the public health law who practices in collaboration with a licensed dentist shall become certified in cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) from an approved provider and thereafter maintain current certification
